title.value: Biomedical image analysis competitions: The state of current participation practice
title.justification: The paper's focus is clearly outlined in its title, which discusses the practice within biomedical image analysis competitions.
title.quote: Biomedical image analysis competitions: The state of current participation practice

extractions.description: This paper analyzes the common practices, strategies, and challenges in algorithm development within biomedical image analysis competitions. It uses data from a survey conducted with participants of the IEEE ISBI 2021 and MICCAI 2021 competitions to investigate these aspects. Key findings are highlighted, including the motivations for participation, time and resource constraints, and the use of deep learning architectures. The paper seeks to provide insights into the status of biomedical image analysis challenges and aims to identify existing gaps in the current literature regarding these competitions.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on biomedical image analysis competitions and their practices. It does not directly address themes related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The number of international benchmarking competitions is steadily increasing in various fields of machine learning (ML) research and practice. So far, however, little is known about the common practice as well as bottlenecks faced by the community in tackling the research questions posed. To shed light on the status quo of algorithm development in the specific field of biomedical imaging analysis, we designed an international survey that was issued to all participants of challenges conducted in conjunction with the IEEE ISBI 2021 and MICCAI 2021 conferences (80 competitions in total).
